title: settings_load_at reads the entire dotfile before any size bound
evidence: data, err := os.read_entire_file_from_path(path, context.temp_allocator); if err != nil || len(data) < 6 {
detail: A multi-GB file at ~/.pp-settings.bin is fully read into memory before the 6-byte minimum check. Local dotfile, no attacker model; low severity.
recommended_fix: Cap the read (e.g. 4KB) or check os.file_size before reading.
